text:
maria: Starting POC w/ Aurora Retail. Requirements: streaming chat, tool/function calls, strict JSON schema output, SAML SSO, and customer-managed KMS. POC hosted but they insist on BYOK and SOC2 doc access. Also want rough cost for bursty peaks (~1k qps for 20m).

aj: Quick clarifying q's: will the demo use browser clients or server-side agents? And do they expect ephemeral creds in the browser?

maria: Browser shoppers + backend enrichment workers. They prefer short-lived creds for browser.

devon: Tech notes: Our JS + Python SDKs support streaming and function calls. Browser: SSE; server: websocket. Function calls arrive as stream chunks with type="function_call" and args as JSON. For schema enforcement we recommend sending a JSON Schema in the system prompt and validating on the client when you receive the final assembled JSON. Example SSE snippet: ```js
const es = new EventSource('\nhttps://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream?model=redwood-13b', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${KEY}` } });
es.onmessage = (e) => { const chunk = JSON.parse(e.data); if (chunk.type === 'function_call') { handle(chunk.name, chunk.args); } };
```

maria: Any risks with short-lived creds + SSE?

devon: Known edge: token rotation mid-stream can produce 401/reconnect thrash for SSE in Node and browsers. Workarounds: 1) proxy tokens server-side and let server rotate/refresh, re-establish streams on 401 and replay session state; or 2) use Dedicated trial long-lived creds for demo. We have a fix coming in PR #1309 that adds client auto-refresh for SSE.

security-bot: BYOK on hosted requires enterprise plan + legal LOA and KMS verification. SOC2 can be shared under NDA. If they need audit log retention or custom retention windows, that is an add-on.

aj: Latency ask: they want ~100ms p50 for short prompts. Can we promise?

devon: For hosted it's best-effort. Dedicated with reserved capacity, quantized model, and batch=1 can hit ~100ms p50 for short replies. Recommend pinned model and prefix caching to stabilize tail latencies.

maria: Pricing: can someone draft a simple cost calc and a short runbook (SSE example, websocket fallback, handling function_call chunks, schema validation, token-rotation workaround)? Include an example cost scenario for 1k qps bursts.

aj: I'll produce a one-page runbook + spreadsheet with hosted vs dedicated comparison and show trial credit and reserved buffer options.

ci-bot: PR #1309 opened by @devon - "sse-client-auto-refresh" (CI queued).

maria: Thanks all. I'll share customer contact (sam@aurora-retail.com) and schedule a demo next Tue. Tagging @devon @aj for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
